title: The Boy Who Breathed Again
story: Elijah Prays for the Little Boy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The widow’s little boy got sick;
his breath had gone away.
Elijah said, “Give me your son,”
and carried him to pray.

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father hears each prayer,
the big ones and the small.
Nothing’s too hard for Him to do,
so pray; He hears it all.

[Verse 2]
Upstairs he laid him on the bed
and prayed, “Oh Lord, please hear!”
The boy took breath! “Your son’s alive!”
His mama held him near.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now fold your hands and close your eyes,
and whisper what you need.
He listened to Elijah’s prayer,
and He hears yours indeed.

[Chorus]
mood: Breathing music. A slow rise and fall under the voice, in and out like a sleeping child’s chest, tender and unhurried. The chorus opens a little wider, like a prayer lifting up the stairs. By the last verse the rise and fall grows slower and lower until it is hardly more than breath.
